official_definition: Once per turn, by sending one core from any of your exactly-named "Grandwalker xxxxxx" to the Trash, immediately activate that Grandwalker Nexus' [LV1][LV2] Grand Skill/Grand Field, treating core as having been sent to the Void.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Minor Unleash] or [Minor Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Minor Unleash]", "give [Minor Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
